items.title: Harman India in Talks with 2W, CV Makers to Supply Infotainment Systems
items.summary: Harman India is in discussions with multiple two-wheeler and commercial vehicle manufacturers to supply in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) and cockpit domain controller (CDC) systems, according to a senior company executive. This would mark Harman Automotive’s expansion beyond its traditional passenger vehicle business in India.

items.title: CEAT to Invest ₹1,205 Crore to Expand Two-Wheeler Tyre Capacity by 66%
items.summary: CEAT plans to invest around ₹1,205 crore to expand its two-wheeler tyre manufacturing capacity by about 66% as the existing capacity at its Nagpur plant nears full utilisation. The tyre maker will add around 53,000 tyres a day in phases by the end of FY31.

items.title: Gabriel India to Invest ₹180 Crore in New Capacity, Automation in FY27
items.summary: Gabriel India plans to invest around ₹180 crore in its standalone business in FY27, with the proposed spending covering a new plant at Hosur and capacity expansion across some of its existing facilities. The company expects a large part of its two-wheeler growth to come from the new Hosur facility, Atul Jaggi, Group President, ANAND Group, and Managing Director of Gabriel India, told Autocar Professional.
